market.question: Will the highest temperature in Jakarta be 34°C on May 7?

assessment.reasoning: Jakarta May 7 forecast 29°C; typical May high 32°C. Question asks for 34°C bin (34-35°C), which is 5°C above forecast and 2°C above typical. Possible during heat spike but not base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Halim airport reading can differ from area forecasts
